body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): End one of your Rites to reduce that Damage by 2. Ending it this way cannot resolve an Echo.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit after the Action.
Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.
